generationArguments.prompt:
Create ONE brand-new TRANSPARENT PNG sprite atlas of exactly 48 genuinely distinct full-body game poses, arranged in a STRICT regular grid of EIGHT COLUMNS by SIX ROWS. Aim a landscape 1536x1152 or similarly readable canvas. Pixel-game illustration, clean detailed readable anatomy, consistent adult proportions and costume throughout. This is new native drawn animation, not official frames. NO text, labels, numbers, grid lines, background, floor, scenery, extra people or opponents. Keep every full head, hand, whole boot sole, weapon and modest effect entirely INSIDE its OWN equal cell, with at least 20px fully transparent gaps all around. Poses never touch neighboring cells. Small subjects: do not crop any toe or gun tip. All 48 are newly articulated DISTINCT poses: do not duplicate or mirror a pose; do not turn one static drawing into variants by color/translation. Predominantly frontal three-quarter, facing RIGHT; avoid back views so the equipment and anatomy stay unambiguous. Same natural body scale in all 48 cells; genuine crouches remain shorter. IDENTITY AND VERSION: Dead Space (2008), living medical officer. Adult Nicole Brennan as a LIVING HUMAN medical officer in the original Dead Space 2008 context: mature fair-skinned woman with shoulder-length auburn/light-brown hair tied back loosely, gray/blue practical medical uniform with subtle white panels, dark practical trousers and low boots. Hands carry at most a small ordinary medical datapad, never a giant console. Calm human face and normal eyes. Not a ghost, no glowing eye sockets, no Marker hallucination, no floating body, no supernatural aura, no magic shield or gun.
 EXACT ORDER: Each HALF-ROW is one FOUR-FRAME animation, left to right. Row0 columns0-3 INTRO: approach, inspect surroundings, settle equipment/gesture, ready stance. Row0 columns4-7 OUTRO: relax, quarter-turn without a back view, departing step, glance back. Row1 columns0-3 ROUND VICTORY: small relieved nod, brief acknowledgment, weight shift, ready again. Row1 columns4-7 ROUND DEFEAT: restrained flinch, step back, small stabilizing half-kneel, recover. Row2 columns0-3 ADAPTED FINALE (non-gory solo presentation, no execution): Nicole reads an ordinary small datapad, indicates an instruction with her free hand, makes a calm stay-back safety gesture and lowers the pad. Zero magical light or beams, no healing sparkle, no projected shield, no medical console appearing. Row2 columns4-7 OVERALL VICTORY: four distinct restrained satisfied gestures, no new power or equipment. Row3 columns0-3 OVERALL DEFEAT: lower shoulders, crouch, whole-body kneeling/seated disappointment, bowed head; no wounds or missing parts. Row3 columns4-7 SUPER: Nicole reads an ordinary small datapad, indicates an instruction with her free hand, makes a calm stay-back safety gesture and lowers the pad. Zero magical light or beams, no healing sparkle, no projected shield, no medical console appearing. These four super drawings must have genuinely different stance/arm articulation from the four finale drawings, not duplicates. Row4 columns0-3 BASE IDLE: four distinct subtle ready poses with changed arms, head and weight. Row4 columns4-7 BASE RUN: four distinct articulated running-cycle steps facing RIGHT, equipment safe. Row5 columns0-3 BASE ACTION: An ordinary medical instruction gesture with small physical datapad, no magic or attack. Row5 columns4-7 BASE HIT REACTION: four different mild non-gory recoils, brace, stagger, recover; no injuries. Every animation's final fourth pose is recovery with NO muzzle flash or active attack effect. All true drawings, NO code effects, no repeated sprites, no painted backdrop. Keep safety gutters and full subjects for every single cell.
